opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Support tends to be around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget or project costs; local community capital projects typically up to £30,000.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations must either have an annual income over £1 million, or total project/capital costs over £1 million. For core costs, annual income must be at least £1 million. UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over for capital/project costs or core costs, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis.
